findings.issue: Record glosses 正 as 'Tadashi' in en, pt, lit_en and lit_pt (matching the canonical EN translation), but kana reads the name as せい — internal contradiction; in-context reading should be ただし.
findings.current: せいわやさしいこえをしている。
findings.suggested: ただしわやさしいこえをしている。

findings.issue: Token 正 has reading せい, but the token's own gloss (and en/pt) identify the person as Tadashi; reading must be ただし to match the record's committed name.
Romaji follows the wrong せい reading of the name 正 (glossed Tadashi throughout the record); should follow ただし.
生きててよかった (〜てよかった) expresses relief/gratitude at being alive; 'This is life!' means savoring the good life — different sense, and inconsistent with pt 'Ainda bem que estou vivo!' and lit_en.

Auxiliary label sits on the wrong て. First て is the te-form ending of 生きる (the 生き note itself says 生きて); the contracted auxiliary (い)て is the SECOND て, now left null. Corpus convention (眠っていた in 142234) puts the auxiliary gloss on the いる element, connector て null.
findings.current: auxiliar de estado contínuo (てる/ている coloquial)
findings.suggested: null (conector て de 生きて); mover gloss/role/note de auxiliar てる para o segundo て

findings.issue: Typo: 'prática-se' uses the noun 'prática' (with accent) where the verb form 'pratica-se' is required.
findings.current: Como é frase de cobertura, prática-se だれも...ない e a negação de adjetivo-な.
findings.suggested: Como é frase de cobertura, pratica-se だれも...ない e a negação de adjetivo-な.

findings.issue: かむようになる uses the plain (non-potential) verb; inserting 'be able to' misrepresents the structure as かめるようになる and contradicts the expl's 'come to (do)' teaching point. lit should mirror 'comes to chew'.
findings.current: The baby comes to be able to chew food.
findings.suggested: The baby comes to chew food.

findings.issue: Stray parenthetical '(very)' in the gloss of 長い — the word just means 'long'; '(very)' is unmotivated noise in this context.
Stray parenthetical '(muito)' in the pt gloss of 長い, mirroring the same noise as the en gloss; 長い means only 'longo'.
